precision_escalation: If inadequacy is observed, retain original outputs and failures; no automatic alteration of this identity or gate. Report unresolved cases and coordinate a distinct reference revision.
comparison_normalization: Each nonzero field by max(abs(level1),abs(level2)); both zero compare exactly. Per-field strict relative agreement also reports any near-zero cancellation field as unresolved rather than hiding it under the global stress scale. Dimensionless source/KKT and polynomial identity residuals use natural scale and at least1 only for reference construction checks, never candidate acceptance.
physical_interface: Exact binary64 E,nu,c,phi,psi interpreted as real numbers; Decimal Taylor sin/cos; exact rational isotropic elastic trial in stored Mandel components followed by mathematical Cartesian shear conversion /sqrt(2).
optional_interface: Resolved binary64 K,G,sf,sd,cf interpreted as exact independent coefficients; value/branch diagnostics only, no derivative admission or replacement of physical interface.
branches: Publish every mathematically defined elastic/face/left/right/apex expression independently, including inadmissible alternatives. Publish selected strict-source classifier, positive/interval margins, eigen gaps and KKT diagnostics. At boundaries no unique classical derivative is invented.
directions: 38 frozen current/parent/loading Mandel directions; no parameter seeds in these columns. Separate E,nu,c,phi,psi analytic directions only for canonical physical interface.
limits: Independent highprecision convergence and polynomial/KKT identities are not rigorous root interval certification, full floating-domain proof, experimental validation or compiled numerical admission.
